panels.description:
Opening time per app, measured over the whole run.

Some apps show a profile screen before the app home. When that happens the opening time is the two steps added together; when it does not, it is the single step. Both land on the same line, so an app can be compared with itself over time. Direct / With Profile / Profile % split that average into the two cases.

Which screens belong to one app opening is read from the navigation tree, not configured here: one press with several possible outcomes (the same rule that colours conditional edges on the canvas), where one outcome leads on to another. A press whose outcomes are two genuinely different endings - play vs resume - is not an app opening and keeps one line per ending in the table below.

An app with no KPI display name on its direct edge shows its destination node instead. The Action Set filter is not applied here (filtering to one step would report a partial opening) and the Report link covers the press, not the profile step.

Same rule the -- canvas colours and the executor uses to recover onto a sibling -- (conditionalEdgeUtils.computeConditionalEdgeIds / navigation_graph). SELECT tree_id, source_node_id, asid FROM edge_as GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(DISTINCT target_node_id) > 1 ), profile_step AS ( -- One outcome of the press is a screen that then leads on to ANOTHER outcome of -- the same press: the profile picker, which leads to the app home. That makes -- the picker an intermediate screen and the screen it leads to the real -- destination. When no outcome leads to another (two genuinely different -- endings, e.g. play vs resume) there is no app row - each ending keeps its own -- line in the table below. panels.description:
Opening time per app, measured over the whole run.

Some apps show a profile screen before the app home. When that happens the opening time is the two steps added together; when it does not, it is the single step. Both land on the same line, so an app can be compared with itself over time. Direct / With Profile / Profile % split that average into the two cases.

Which screens belong to one app opening is read from the navigation tree, not configured here: one press with several possible outcomes (the same rule that colours conditional edges on the canvas), where one outcome leads on to another. A press whose outcomes are two genuinely different endings - play vs resume - is not an app opening and keeps one line per ending in the table below.

An app with no KPI display name on its direct edge shows its destination node instead. The Action Set filter is not applied here (filtering to one step would report a partial opening) and the Report link covers the press, not the profile step.

targets.rawSql: WITH edge_as AS ( -- Every edge with the fields of its FORWARD (default) action set. The grouping -- below is a forward-only property, so the reverse set is never considered. SELECT ne.tree_id, ne.edge_id, ne.source_node_id, ne.target_node_id, ne.default_action_set_id AS asid, s.a->>'kpi_name' AS kpi_name, (s.a->>'threshold')::int AS threshold FROM navigation_edges ne LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a FROM jsonb_array_elements(ne.action_sets) a WHERE a->>'id' = ne.default_action_set_id LIMIT 1) s ON true ), grp AS ( -- One button press with several possible outcomes: 2+ edges leaving the same -- node with the same default_action_set_id to DIFFERENT targets. Same rule the -- canvas colours and the executor uses to recover onto a sibling -- (conditionalEdgeUtils.computeConditionalEdgeIds / navigation_graph). SELECT tree_id, source_node_id, asid FROM edge_as GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(DISTINCT target_node_id) > 1 ), profile_step AS ( -- One outcome of the press is a screen that then leads on to ANOTHER outcome of -- the same press: the profile picker, which leads to the app home. That makes -- the picker an intermediate screen and the screen it leads to the real -- destination. When no outcome leads to another (two genuinely different -- endings, e.g. play vs resume) there is no app row - each ending keeps its own -- line in the table below. SELECT e.tree_id, e.source_node_id AS press_node, e.asid, e.target_node_id AS profile_node, MIN(c.target_node_id) AS app_node FROM edge_as e JOIN grp g ON g.tree_id=e.tree_id AND g.source_node_id=e.source_node_id AND g.asid=e.asid JOIN edge_as c ON c.tree_id=e.tree_id AND c.source_node_id=e.target_node_id JOIN edge_as sib ON sib.tree_id=e.tree_id AND sib.source_node_id=e.source_node_id AND sib.asid=e.asid AND sib.target_node_id=c.target_node_id WHERE c.target_node_id <> e.target_node_id GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ), app_step AS ( -- The three edges that make up one app opening, keyed by (press node, app node). panels.description:
Opening time per app, measured over the whole run.

Some apps show a profile screen before the app home. When that happens the opening time is the two steps added together; when it does not, it is the single step. Both land on the same line, so an app can be compared with itself over time. Direct / With Profile / Profile % split that average into the two cases.

Which screens belong to one app opening is read from the navigation tree, not configured here: one press with several possible outcomes (the same rule that colours conditional edges on the canvas), where one outcome leads on to another. A press whose outcomes are two genuinely different endings - play vs resume - is not an app opening and keeps one line per ending in the table below.

An app with no KPI display name on its direct edge shows its destination node instead. The Action Set filter is not applied here (filtering to one step would report a partial opening) and the Report link covers the press, not the profile step.

targets.rawSql: WITH edge_as AS ( -- Every edge with the fields of its FORWARD (default) action set. The grouping -- below is a forward-only property, so the reverse set is never considered. SELECT ne.tree_id, ne.edge_id, ne.source_node_id, ne.target_node_id, ne.default_action_set_id AS asid, s.a->>'kpi_name' AS kpi_name, (s.a->>'threshold')::int AS threshold FROM navigation_edges ne LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a FROM jsonb_array_elements(ne.action_sets) a WHERE a->>'id' = ne.default_action_set_id LIMIT 1) s ON true ), grp AS ( -- One button press with several possible outcomes: 2+ edges leaving the same -- node with the same default_action_set_id to DIFFERENT targets. Same rule the -- canvas colours and the executor uses to recover onto a sibling -- (conditionalEdgeUtils.computeConditionalEdgeIds / navigation_graph). SELECT tree_id, source_node_id, asid FROM edge_as GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(DISTINCT target_node_id) > 1 ), profile_step AS ( -- One outcome of the press is a screen that then leads on to ANOTHER outcome of -- the same press: the profile picker, which leads to the app home. That makes -- the picker an intermediate screen and the screen it leads to the real -- destination. When no outcome leads to another (two genuinely different -- endings, e.g. play vs resume) there is no app row - each ending keeps its own -- line in the table below. SELECT e.tree_id, e.source_node_id AS press_node, e.asid, e.target_node_id AS profile_node, MIN(c.target_node_id) AS app_node FROM edge_as e JOIN grp g ON g.tree_id=e.tree_id AND g.source_node_id=e.source_node_id AND g.asid=e.asid JOIN edge_as c ON c.tree_id=e.tree_id AND c.source_node_id=e.target_node_id JOIN edge_as sib ON sib.tree_id=e.tree_id AND sib.source_node_id=e.source_node_id AND sib.asid=e.asid AND sib.target_node_id=c.target_node_id WHERE c.target_node_id <> e.target_node_id GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ), app_step AS ( -- The three edges that make up one app opening, keyed by (press node, app node). SELECT e.tree_id, e.edge_id, p.press_node, p.app_node, p.asid AS grp_asid, 'direct' AS role FROM edge_as e JOIN profile_step p ON p.tree_id=e.tree_id AND p.press_node=e.source_node_id AND p.asid=e.asid AND e.target_node_id=p.app_node UNION ALL SELECT e.tree_id, e.edge_id, p.press_node, p.app_node, p.asid, 'to_profile' FROM edge_as e JOIN profile_step p ON p.tree_id=e.tree_id AND p.press_node=e.source_node_id AND p.asid=e.asid AND e.target_node_id=p.profile_node UNION ALL SELECT c.tree_id, c.edge_id, p.press_node, p.app_node, p.asid, 'profile_to_app' FROM edge_as c JOIN profile_step p ON p.tree_id=c.tree_id AND c.source_node_id=p.profile_node AND c.target_node_id=p.app_node ), app_name AS ( -- Name the app after the KPI display name of the edge that opens it directly; -- fall back to any named step, then to the destination node's own label. SELECT a.tree_id, a.press_node, a.app_node, COALESCE(MAX(ea.kpi_name) FILTER (WHERE a.role='direct' AND COALESCE(ea.kpi_name,'') <> ''), MAX(ea.kpi_name) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(ea.kpi_name,'') <> ''), MAX(an.label)) AS name FROM app_step a JOIN edge_as ea ON ea.tree_id=a.tree_id AND ea.edge_id=a.edge_id LEFT JOIN navigation_nodes an ON an.node_id=a.app_node AND an.tree_id=a.tree_id GROUP BY 1,2,3 ), steps AS ( SELECT er.script_result_id AS run_id, er.success, er.kpi_measurement_ms AS ms, COALESCE(er.device_model,'unknown') AS model, COALESCE(er.variant,'Base') AS variant, a.tree_id, a.press_node, a.app_node, a.grp_asid, a.role, COALESCE(ea.threshold, 0) AS threshold FROM (SELECT * FROM execution_results WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = execution_results.host_name AND df.device_name = execution_results.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ','))) AND ('${environment:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM script_results sr_env WHERE sr_env.id = execution_results.script_result_id AND sr_env.environment = ANY(string_to_array('${environment:csv}', ','))))) er LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id JOIN edge_as ea ON ea.tree_id = er.tree_id AND ea.edge_id = regexp_replace(er.edge_id, '_reverse$', '') AND ea.asid = er.action_set_id JOIN app_step a ON a.tree_id = ea.tree_id AND a.edge_id = ea.edge_id WHERE er.kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL AND er.script_result_id IS NOT NULL AND ui.name = 'stb_android_mobile' AND $__timeFilter(er.executed_at) AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring})) AND (COALESCE(er.device_model, 'unknown') IN (${model:sqlstring})) ), runs AS ( -- One row per (run, app): the steps are added up INSIDE the run, so a run that -- opened the app directly and a run that passed the profile screen both end up -- as one opening time. A profile->app step with no press in the same run is not -- an app opening (the script started on the profile screen) and is dropped. SELECT run_id, tree_id, press_node, app_node, variant, model, MAX(grp_asid) AS grp_asid, SUM(ms) AS total_ms, SUM(threshold) AS threshold_ms, BOOL_AND(success) AS ok, BOOL_OR(role = 'to_profile') AS took_profile FROM steps GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6 HAVING BOOL_OR(role <> 'profile_to_app') ) SELECT r.variant || ' - ' || an.name AS "Variant - App", r.model AS "Model", CASE WHEN ROUND(AVG(r.threshold_ms))::int > 0 AND ROUND(AVG(r.total_ms))::int > ROUND(AVG(r.threshold_ms))::int THEN 'OVER:' || ROUND(AVG(r.total_ms))::int::text ELSE 'OK:' || ROUND(AVG(r.total_ms))::int::text END AS "Avg KPI (ms)", ROUND(AVG(r.total_ms) FILTER (WHERE NOT r.took_profile))::int AS "Direct (ms)", ROUND(AVG(r.total_ms) FILTER (WHERE r.took_profile))::int AS "With Profile (ms)", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.took_profile) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "Profile %", ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN r.ok THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::decimal / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 1) AS "Success", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT r.ok) AS "Failures", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.ok AND r.threshold_ms > 0 AND r.total_ms > r.threshold_ms) AS "Over Threshold", ROUND(AVG(r.threshold_ms))::int AS "Threshold (ms)", COUNT(*) AS "Count", ('link') AS "Report" FROM runs r JOIN app_name an ON an.tree_id=r.tree_id AND an.press_node=r.press_node AND an.app_node=r.app_node GROUP BY r.variant, an.name, r.model ORDER BY "Variant - App" ASC

list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ui.name FROM execution_results er LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id WHERE (er.kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR er.kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL) AND $__timeFilter(er.executed_at) AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring})) ORDER BY ui.name

list.description: Run scope. Empty = base run (no --variant). Each variant aggregates separately on edge_metrics — 'All' shows combined volume across scopes.
list.label: Variant
list.name: variant
list.query: SELECT 'Base' AS variant UNION SELECT name FROM userinterface_variants UNION SELECT DISTINCT variant FROM execution_results WHERE variant IS NOT NULL ORDER BY variant

list.label: Model
list.name: model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(device_model, 'unknown') AS model FROM execution_results WHERE kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.description: STB hardware model derived from device_get_info serial. Filters the stb_tv radar.
list.label: STB Model
list.name: stb_model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT SPLIT_PART(serial, '-', 2) AS model FROM (SELECT COALESCE(metadata->'info'->>'serial_number_stb', metadata->'info'->>'seriennummer_stb') AS serial FROM script_results WHERE script_name IN ('get_info', 'device_get_info') AND COALESCE(metadata->'info'->>'serial_number_stb', metadata->'info'->>'seriennummer_stb') IS NOT NULL) t ORDER BY model

list.description: STB software build derived from device_get_info software_version (the PRD-..-AL core). Filters the stb_tv radar.
list.label: Software Version
list.name: software
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(software, '^.*?-MON-', ''), '-[0-9]{6,}.*$', '') AS sw FROM (SELECT COALESCE(metadata->'info'->>'software_version', metadata->'info'->>'softwareversion') AS software FROM script_results WHERE script_name IN ('get_info', 'device_get_info') AND COALESCE(metadata->'info'->>'software_version', metadata->'info'->>'softwareversion') IS NOT NULL) t WHERE software LIKE '%-MON-%' ORDER BY sw

list.label: Action Set
list.name: action_set
list.query:
SELECT CASE
  WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sr.script_name = 'standby_measurement' AND COALESCE(lbl.edge_label, '') NOT ILIKE '%standby%' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(er.kpi_display_label, '') END) = 0
    THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(lbl.edge_label, ''), NULLIF(lbl.kpi_name, ''), er.action_set_id)
  WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sr.script_name = 'standby_measurement' AND COALESCE(lbl.edge_label, '') NOT ILIKE '%standby%' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(er.kpi_display_label, '') END) = 1
    AND MIN(CASE WHEN sr.script_name = 'standby_measurement' AND COALESCE(lbl.edge_label, '') NOT ILIKE '%standby%' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(er.kpi_display_label, '') END) = COALESCE(NULLIF(lbl.edge_label, ''), NULLIF(lbl.kpi_name, ''), er.action_set_id)
    THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(lbl.edge_label, ''), NULLIF(lbl.kpi_name, ''), er.action_set_id)
  ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(lbl.edge_label, ''), NULLIF(lbl.kpi_name, ''), er.action_set_id)
    || ' — ' || STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sr.script_name = 'standby_measurement' AND COALESCE(lbl.edge_label, '') NOT ILIKE '%standby%' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(er.kpi_display_label, '') END, ', ')
  END AS __text, er.action_set_id AS __value
FROM execution_results er
LEFT JOIN script_results sr ON er.script_result_id = sr.id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT as_elem->>'kpi_name' AS kpi_name, as_elem->>'label' AS edge_label
  FROM navigation_edges ne, jsonb_array_elements(ne.action_sets) AS as_elem
  WHERE ne.edge_id = regexp_replace(er.edge_id, '_reverse$', '')
    AND ne.tree_id = er.tree_id
    AND as_elem->>'id' = er.action_set_id
  LIMIT 1
) lbl ON true
WHERE er.kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR er.kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY er.action_set_id
ORDER BY __text
